aboutGame.title: What is Readventures?
paragraphs: Readventures is an anime-inspired action adventure and tactical tower defense game on Roblox. Players summon and command iconic heroes across challenging campaign stages, wave defenses, and competitive tournaments, combining elemental attacks, crowd control, and unit synergies.

Whether you are mastering unit placement, executing optimal buff cycles with Erwin, or farming gems for Mythic summons like Akainu and Shanks, our wiki provides complete data tables, progression roadmaps, and verified strategies.

faq.title: Readventures Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Readventures gameplay, summoning, units, and updates.

items.question: What kind of game is Readventures?
items.answer: Readventures is an anime action and tactical tower defense game on Roblox where players summon iconic characters, tackle campaign waves, and battle through competitive tournaments.

items.question: How do I progress as a beginner in Readventures?
items.answer: Focus on clearing the main story acts to unlock core gameplay systems, save your gems for high-value summon banners, and balance your Readventures squad with damage dealers and support buffers like Erwin.

items.question: What are the best units in Readventures?
items.answer: Top-ranked Readventures units include Erwin for squad-wide damage buff cycling, Akainu for devastating area-of-effect burns, and Shanks for lethal single-target boss burst.

items.question: How do I farm gems and reroll tokens in Readventures?
items.answer: In Readventures, you can earn gems by completing first-time story milestones, participating in daily challenges, and clearing tournament mode waves to fuel your character summons and trait rerolls.

items.question: Where can I find the latest Readventures updates and patch notes?
items.answer: Our Readventures wiki documents every game update, including new unit releases, balance adjustments, and official community announcements from Discord and YouTube.
